source: sars-guide:SARS ETI page ("How much is the incentive"; employee conditions), fetched 2026-11-07
notes: June 2025 (tax year 2026), employee aged 24, employed since 1 March 2024 (month 16: second 12 months), 160 hours (R31.25 an hour, above the R28.79 minimum). R5 000 is in the flat band: second-year R750.00. PAYE nil. UIF 50.00, SDL 50.00, net 4 950.00. National minimum wage R28.79 an ordinary hour from 1 March 2025 (Minister of Employment and Labour, gov.za media statement 5 Feb 2025, "binding from 1 March 2025"; GN R. 5830, Gazette 52053): R4 606.40 for 160 hours. SARS: the employee must be paid at least the minimum wage, and ETI for fewer than 160 hours is grossed up to 160 and the result grossed down by the same ratio.
